audit_items.proof_trace: saturating_sub(base, hourly_drop * hours) enforces both invariants: (1) non-negativity is guaranteed by float.move:55-61 which floors at 0 when reduction exceeds base, and (2) monotonic decrease holds because hours = secs_since_activation / 3600 is non-decreasing as the Sui clock advances, making reduction non-decreasing, making the returned LTV threshold non-increasing. All callers compute secs_since_activation via get_secs_since_activation which asserts the clock has passed the activation timestamp.
